predictions.selection_reason: Modified call to pass object parameter -> enables object-specific security validation -> prevents prototype pollution attacks
predictions.source_summary: Object properties come from parsed mathematical expressions via parseObject() in parse.js. Keys are parsed from tokens (symbols or quoted strings), values from parseAssignment().
predictions.sink_summary: The candidate guards against unsafe property access during compilation to JavaScript code. Unsafe properties would throw an error preventing compilation.
predictions.guard_summary: isSafeProperty checks for prototype pollution risks: blocks properties ghosted in prototype chain, inherited from Object/Function prototypes, allows only whitelisted native properties like 'length'.
predictions.risk_pattern: Prevents prototype pollution by validating object property keys during expression compilation, blocking access to dangerous inherited properties like 'constructor', 'toString', etc.
predictions.context_summary: Added security check in object node compilation to prevent prototype pollution attacks by validating property keys against dangerous inherited properties.
unresolved_facts: Specific attack vectors that could exploit unsafe properties in mathematical expressions
Whether user input can directly control object property keys in parsed expressions

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

top_sast_rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
top_sast_rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper output encoding based on context (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URL). Use Content Security Policy and validate input.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
top_sast_rules.description: A 'for' loop that increments its loop variable but checks it against a lower bound, or decrements its loop variable but checks it against an upper bound, will either stop iterating immediately or keep iterating indefinitely, and is usually indicative of a typo.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement loop bounds and timeout mechanisms. Add maximum iteration counts. Use break conditions that cannot be controlled by user input.

top_sast_rules.description: Security-critical data assumed immutable can be modified by an attacker.
